name: Native binding signature preservation requires a bound native fixture

input.fixture_ref: Bind a native Method with declared primitive and handle parameters, then cross valid and invalid arguments and returns through its recorded Contract.

applicability.reason: Requires a BOUND native fixture. FFI.open answers an FFI::Library and lib.bind reaches IncompleteNativeSignatureError, so the surface exists, but every path ends at a refusal and no fixture supplies a completed signature whose recorded Contract could guard arguments and returns.

expect.status: Metadata callable signature is preserved and every written Contract remains a static and runtime boundary guard.
